_help: RingGo locations inside Lambeth, copied by hand from the RingGo parking locator (https://myringgo.co.uk/parkinglocator: name search plus each site's tariff summary). All are off-street car parks; Lambeth's own street bays use PayByPhone. Every site below was checked to be inside the London Borough of Lambeth boundary (OpenStreetMap). Add a site: code, name, operator, lat, lng, max_stay, price, note, info_url. Optional charging hours in the same form as the council pay-by-phone data (hours like "08:00-20:00,Sa 08:00-13:00", days like "Monday - Friday"): outside them the app says CHECK THE SIGNS (estate car parks may be residents only), except on free_days RingGo lists as free (e.g. "Su"), when it says FREE. Without hours it always says PAY. Delete a site to drop it.
